entries.reason: Inventory mutations and prepared batches publish their access, commit and observer contracts even though Bags are domain containers rather than ECS entities.
entries.entity_scope: caller-owned Bag and EquipmentSet domain containers; no ECS entity traversal
entries.view: one owning-thread Bag snapshot captured during preparation and compared in full before commit
entries.read_set: item definitions, Bag configuration, filters, capacity and stack policies, slots and custom properties
entries.write_set: the target Bag slot vector plus the inventory event queue after successful commit
entries.structural_changes: prepared additions mutate only a private candidate; commit swaps the target slot vector once and never changes ECS structure
entries.events: inventory change hooks and poll events publish only after the authoritative slot swap; failed and stale batches publish nothing
entries.services: process-local item registry and named inventory policies on the Bag owning simulation thread
entries.phase: gameplay transaction commit after validation and before downstream inventory presentation polling

entries.reason: Inventory snapshots use the protobuf message descriptor as their structural contract and validate domain policies before publication.
entries.schema: eve.inventory.proto.InventorySave in proto/inventory_save.proto; legacy JSON is a protobuf JSON projection
entries.migration: Existing version-1 JSON is read through protobuf JSON mapping. The pure ID-rewrite API supports explicit cross-content save migrations; unsupported wire versions fail before mutation.
entries.unknown_fields: Reject unknown protobuf fields recursively and reject unknown JSON fields during protobuf JSON parsing.
entries.restore_atomicity: Parse and validate into private Bag and EquipmentSet candidates, then publish both via no-fail swaps.

entries.reason: Inventory exposes an owning-thread protobuf save boundary alongside its existing script-facing JSON projection.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this change.

entries.thread_affinity: All capture, validation and commit calls run on the owning simulation thread.
cost_notes: Binary and JSON snapshot operations are O(total inventory state) at save/load boundaries.
